result.topic_en: Calculations relating series in fractional powers of x and y to theta-type expansions, and expressing the lemniscatic-type functions φα, fα, Fα as quotients S/P, R/P, Q/P of functions of x = h^{ω/ϖ}, y = h^{-2α/ϖ}, with periods linked to arithmetic-geometric means of √(cc+ee) and c, e.
